rule_plates: Plates compared without spaces, dashes or case
rule_formats: Dates as dd/mm/yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd, weights in kilograms

customers_subtitle: {count} active · shared by every branch of the company

units_footer: Times in Europe/Paris · a unit ending at 20:00 and another starting at 20:00 do not overlap
free_hint: Active resources that belong to no unit at that moment.
action_change_unit_named: Change the driver or trailer of {name}
new_unit_unavailable: In the unit {unit}, with no end: give it an end to start another.
unit_form_hint: Only active resources free over the whole period can be chosen
power_unit_hint: One power unit per unit: a tractor, a rigid truck or a light van.

licence_hint: Drivers without this category cannot be chosen.

documents_choose_power_unit: Choose a power unit to see the documents the unit needs.
unit_started_hint: This unit has started: it is never edited in place. It can be given an end, or a new driver or trailer from a date.

in_unit: This resource belongs to the unit {unit} ({period}). End the unit first.
unit_started: This unit has started: it can only be given an end.
unit_not_started: This unit has not started yet: edit it instead.
reason_drawbar_trailer: Drawbar trailer: needs a rigid truck
reason_light_van: A light van takes no trailer
reason_be: Needs a BE licence, which Timon does not manage
issue_driver_or_trailer_required: a unit needs a driver or a trailer besides its power unit
issue_subsidiary_mismatch: the members belong to different subsidiaries
issue_end_not_after_start: the end must be after the start
issue_outside_unit: the change must fall after the start of the unit and before its end
leave_text: The changes on this page are not saved. Leaving loses them.

confirm_archive_resource_text: It disappears from the lists and the planning. It is never deleted and can be restored.
confirm_archive_customer_text: It disappears from the lists. Its usual sites stay active. It is never deleted and can be restored.
confirm_archive_site_text: It disappears from the lists; the customers that use it keep it among their usual sites. It is never deleted and can be restored.
confirm_remove_document_text: The document is deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_unit_text: This unit has not started yet. It is deleted, and this cannot be undone.
page_not_found_text: There is no page at this address. It may have moved, or the link may be wrong.

duplicate_banner: Copy of {number}: set the dates of the stops, then create the order.
goods_hint: Each line leaves from a pickup and goes to a delivery of this order. The totals add up the lines.

history_recorded_text: The creation, by hand, by import with its file, or by the demo generator; every change with the fields changed, old and new; every change of status with its reason; a split and a duplication.

issue_header_disagrees: {field} differs from line {line}, which starts the same order
issue_invalid_time: {field}: “{value}” is not a time as hh:mm
issue_site_ambiguous: {field}: {count} active sites are named “{value}”; rename one of them
issue_split_group_empty: each group needs at least one goods line
order_import_errors_text: Nothing is imported until the file is free of errors. Add the missing customers or sites, or correct the file, then choose it again.
order_import_ready: Every line is valid. Orders with several pickups and several deliveries, or a site not located, are imported to review.
rule_order_grouping: One line per goods line; lines with the same customer code and reference form one order and must agree on body type, side loading, tail lift and notes
rule_order_references: Customers by their code, sites by their exact name in the address book; a line without a reference is an order of its own
rule_order_review: An order with several pickups and several deliveries, or a site not located, is imported to review
split_banner: This request has {shape}: an order needs a single pickup or a single delivery. Sort its goods lines into two groups; each group takes the stops its lines use. Nothing is split until you confirm.
split_cancelled: This order is cancelled: it cannot be split.
split_new_hint: gets the next number when split
split_not_splittable: Only an order to review with several pickups and several deliveries can be split.
split_note: Both orders become to plan if nothing else is left to fix. Both histories record the split, with the other order's number. A group that still has the wrong shape can be split again.
split_stays_hint: keeps its number and its history
template_text_orders: One line per goods line; column names in English or French. Dates as dd/mm/yyyy or yyyy-mm-dd, times as hh:mm.
warning_no_reference: No reference: one order per line
